docScanIntro: Take a photo of a bank document: we read the details for you.
docScanFormats: Photos only: JPEG, PNG or WebP, 10 MB maximum.
docScanAgentReview: Some details must be checked: an agent will review this document and reply in this chat.
docScanNeedsReview: Some details could not be read with certainty. Check them before using them.
docScanErrPdf: Only photos of documents can be read for now. Take a photo of the page or choose a JPEG, PNG or WebP image.
docScanErrUnsupported: This file type cannot be read. Choose a JPEG, PNG or WebP photo.
docScanErrTooLarge: The photo is larger than 10 MB. Take it again at a smaller size.
docScanErrInvalid: The photo could not be read. Try again with a clear photo of the document.
docScanErrUnavailable: Document reading is not available right now.
docScanErrGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.
